slides.title: Agents Chain Steps Without Manual Handoffs
bullets: Agents execute task sequences semi-autonomously, unlike a simple chatbot
Combine search, analysis, and content generation in one continuous flow
No human intervention needed at each intermediate step
Requires even more human oversight discipline than a one-off chat tool

slides.title: A Weekly Literature Summary, End to End
bullets: Automatically review new publications in a therapeutic area each week
Filter for relevance against predefined criteria
Extract key data from each relevant publication
Generate a first draft weekly summary for the field team

slides.title: Where Agents Are Showing Up in Medical Affairs
bullets: Continuous literature and medical listening surveillance from Module 10
Automatic alerts on publications tied to priority evidence gaps
Semi-automatic first drafts of congress debrief reports from Module 8
Automatic grouping and prioritization of MSL-captured insights

slides.title: Human-in-the-Loop Is Non-Negotiable
bullets: Agents can run mechanical, low-risk steps on their own
Any output going external, making a scientific claim, or feeding a decision needs human approval
Same rigor as any other AI-generated content in this module

slides.title: Still an Active Work in Progress
bullets: Not yet a fully mature, standardized practice in the sector
Teams that succeed start with low-risk, high-volume repetitive tasks
They keep rigorous human review on every relevant output
They document what the agent did and what review was applied

takeaway.title: AI agents extend automation further, but human-in-the-loop review scales with them
bullets: Agents chain multiple steps into one flow without per-step human input
Every externally facing or decision-relevant output still needs human sign-off
Start with low-risk, high-volume tasks and document the review trail
